title: Share a real-directory chain check for repository file moves
body:
Evidence: PR #151 review record 1 (2026-10-31): both BLOCKING findings were symlinked ancestors (<worktree>/.krn, <main>/.krn/runs) followed by lstat of a leaf; GLOBAL ship has assertDirectoryChainWithoutSymlinks, Product deliver re-implemented it ad hoc.
Acceptance: one Product helper asserts every component from a root to a path is a real directory (lstat), deliver hygiene uses it, and a unit test covers a symlinked middle component red at the base.
